narrative.northStar: The live camera is the main surface
narrative.overview: Zeekr Companion uses a quiet native Android surface with neutral light and dark themes, orange selection and action accents, and a separate recording-red vocabulary. The owner-approved linked-companions mark provides identity alongside familiar Material controls. This records the built system; it introduces no replacement font, palette or logo.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic day/night colors resolved by Android resources.
Native system typography in six named sp roles.
Flat tonal controls, modest rounded corners and clear touch spacing.
Truthful camera, recording and pending-change states.

rules.name: Separate Meanings
rules.body: Orange marks ordinary action and selection. Red marks recording and destructive operations; amber marks locked footage.

rules.name: Native Scale
rules.body: Use the existing named sp roles and native system font scaling; keep literal text sizes out of new core layouts.

rules.name: Flat Controls
rules.body: The bottom toolbar has transparent controls and native press/focus feedback; recording retains its red indicator and progress. Header and dialog actions keep tonal surfaces.

rules.name: Action and state clarity
rules.body: Name the next window action as well as current state; preview restart guidance remains visible before Save. Playback Home returns to cameras, while Back follows the gallery stack.

rules.name: Applied preview and compact recording
rules.body: The selector names applied preview sources; the reopen notice names the saved next choice. Hide inactive arrangement tiles for one source. Keep recording action and clip detail in the toolbar, with live screen-off behavior in long-press Recording details.

dos: Do resolve colors through the incumbent semantic Android resources in both themes.
Do use the six TextAppearance.Cam roles and preserve system font scaling.
Do keep the approved linked-companions vector mark and its geometry.
Do keep recording, preview selection and independent windows visually and behaviorally distinct.
Do keep long translated labels readable by wrapping and allowing controls to grow.
donts: Don't replace missing or stale camera output with a fabricated vehicle scene.
Don't use recording red as an interchangeable selection accent.
Don't change recording mapping, quality, source ownership or calibrated projection when arranging preview panes.
Don't rename the Android package, signing identity, storage folder or repository as a branding side effect.
Don't claim vehicle fit, startup, frame rate or factory-camera coexistence from emulator screenshots.
